description: change-history.md never mentions DCP, despite change history recording the same mutation stream DCP relays, and gives no architectural account of how mutations reach the change history at all - whether via the internal path DCP uses or a separate write path inside Magma. The only consumer named for reading its contents is the Kafka Connector, not a DCP client. Readers evaluating change history against an existing DCP-based pipeline have nothing to compare.
